oecd_matched_value_added.description: Original OECD same-industry real/nominal gross value added for the international method.

publisher_candidates.potential_original_measure: gross value added (published nominal and volume components)
publisher_candidates.required_original_checks: Establish original STAN GVA measurement, industry classification, current/volume price basis, currency, same years and original revision metadata.

oecd_matched_hours.description: Original OECD total hours worked for the identical country-industry scope.

publisher_candidates.potential_original_measure: annual hours worked (employees and self-employed where published)
publisher_candidates.required_original_checks: Establish matching industry scope, hours units, employee/proprietor perimeter and aligned periods before comparing output per hour.

oecd_matched_compensation.description: Original OECD employee-plus-imputed-self-employed compensation for the identical scope.

expected.concept: Total labour compensation with documented imputation

publisher_candidates.potential_original_measure: labour compensation, including any imputed self-employed component
publisher_candidates.required_original_checks: Verify whether publisher reports/imputes self-employed labour compensation for the exact same industry, year and hours perimeter; employee-only pay is insufficient.

oecd_matched_output_deflator.description: Original OECD same-industry value-added deflator; a CPI measure is a distinct question.

publisher_candidates.potential_original_measure: same-industry value-added volume and current-price basis for deflator
publisher_candidates.required_original_checks: Verify explicit original implicit VA deflator or a documented same-release current/volume identity, chain-linking and common index reference; do not use CPI.
